book: Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Examinations — R.S. Aggarwal

questions.question: January 1, 2007 was Monday. What day of the week lies on Jan. 1, 2008?
questions.explanation: The year 2007 is an ordinary year. So, it has 1 odd day. 1st day of the year 2007 was Monday. 1st day of the year 2008 will be 1 day beyond Monday. Hence, it will be Tuesday.

questions.question: January 1, 2008 is Tuesday. What day of the week lies on Jan. 1, 2009?
questions.explanation: The year 2008 is a leap year. So, it has 2 odd days. 1st day of the year 2008 is Tuesday (Given) So, 1st day of the year 2009 is 2 days beyond Tuesday. Hence, it will be Thursday.

questions.question: On 8th Dec, 2007 Saturday falls. What day of the week was it on 8th Dec. 2006?
questions.explanation: The year 2006 is an ordinary year. So, it has 1 odd day. So, the day on 8th Dec, 2007 will be 1 day beyond the day on 8th Dec, 2006. But, 8th Dec, 2007 is Saturday. ∴ 8th Dec, 2006 is Friday.

questions.question: On 6th March, 2005 Monday falls. What was the day of the week on 6th March, 2004?
questions.explanation: The year 2004 is a leap year. So, it has 2 odd days. ∴ The day on 6th March, 2005 will be 2 days beyond the day on 6th March, 2004. But, 6th March, 2005 is Monday. ∴ 6th March, 2004 is Saturday.

questions.question: The calendar for the year 2007 will be the same for the year:
questions.explanation: Count the number of odd days from the year 2007 onwards to get the sum equal to 0 odd day. 2007(1) + 2008(2) + 2009(1) + 2010(1) + 2011(1) + 2012(2) + 2013(1) + 2014(1) + 2015(1) + 2016(2) + 2017(1) = 14 odd days ≡ 0 odd day. ∴ Calendar for the year 2018 will be the same as for the year 2007.

questions.question: On what dates of April, 2001 did Wednesday fall?
questions.explanation: 1st April, 2001 = 2000 years + Period from 1.1.2001 to 1.4.2001. 2000 years have 0 odd days. Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + 1 = 91 days ≡ 0 odd days. 1st April 2001 was Sunday. Thus Wednesdays fell on 4th, 11th, 18th, 25th April.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 17th June, 1998?
questions.explanation: 1600 yrs = 0, 300 yrs = 1 odd day. 97 yrs = 24 leap + 73 ord = 48 + 73 = 121 days ≡ 2 odd days. Jan(3) + Feb(0) + Mar(3) + Apr(2) + May(3) + 17 June = 28 days ≡ 0 odd days. Total odd days = 1 + 2 + 0 = 3 ⇒ Wednesday.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 28th May, 2006?
questions.explanation: 2000 yrs = 0 odd days. 5 yrs = 1 leap + 4 ord = 6 odd days ≡ 6. Jan(3) + Feb(0) + Mar(3) + Apr(2) + 28 May = 36 days ≡ 1 odd day. Total = 6 + 1 = 7 ≡ 0 odd days ⇒ Sunday.

questions.question: What will be the day of the week on 15th August, 2010?
questions.explanation: 2000 yrs = 0. 9 yrs = 2 leap + 7 ord = 11 days ≡ 4 odd days. Jan(3)+Feb(0)+Mar(3)+Apr(2)+May(3)+Jun(2)+Jul(3)+15 Aug = 31 days ≡ 3 odd days. Total = 4 + 3 = 7 ≡ 0 odd days ⇒ Sunday.

questions.question: Today is Monday. After 61 days, it will be
questions.explanation: 61 ÷ 7 = 8 weeks + 5 odd days. Monday + 5 days = Saturday.

questions.question: The last day of a century cannot be
questions.explanation: 100 yrs = 5 odd days (Fri), 200 yrs = 3 odd days (Wed), 300 yrs = 1 odd day (Mon), 400 yrs = 0 odd days (Sun). Thus last day of a century can be Sun, Mon, Wed, Fri, but cannot be Tue, Thu, Sat.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a leap year?
questions.explanation: A century year is a leap year only if it is divisible by 400. 700 is not divisible by 400, so it is not a leap year.

questions.question: How many days are there in x weeks x days?
questions.explanation: x weeks = 7x days. Total days = 7x + x = 8x days.

questions.question: It was Sunday on Jan 1, 2006. What was the day of the week on Jan 1, 2010?
questions.explanation: Years 2006(1) + 2007(1) + 2008(2) + 2009(1) = 5 odd days. Sunday + 5 days = Friday.

questions.question: On 8th Feb, 2005 it was Tuesday. What was the day of the week on 8th Feb, 2004?
questions.explanation: 2004 was a leap year, so Feb 2004 had 29 days. Between 8 Feb 2004 and 8 Feb 2005, 366 days elapsed = 2 odd days. 8th Feb 2004 was Tuesday - 2 days = Sunday.

questions.question: For a certain month, the dates of three of the Sundays are even numbers. Then, the 15th of that month falls on a [SSC—CGL (Tier I) Exam, 2012]
questions.explanation: The dates of three Sundays being even numbers must be 2, 16, 30 (odd Sundays on 9, 23). If 16th is Sunday, then 15th is Saturday.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 15 August, 1947? [DMRC— Customer Relationship Assistant (CRA) Exam, 2016]
questions.explanation: 1600 yrs = 0, 300 yrs = 1 odd day. 46 yrs = 11 leap + 35 ord = 57 days ≡ 1 odd day. Jan to Jul 1947 + 15 days Aug = 16 odd days ≡ 2 odd days. Total odd days = 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 5 odd days ⇒ Friday.

questions.question: The calendar for the year 2009 will be the same as that of the year [DMRC— Customer Relationship Assistant (CRA) Exam, 2016]
questions.explanation: Sum of odd days from 2009 to 2014: 2009(1) + 2010(1) + 2011(1) + 2012(2) + 2013(1) + 2014(1) = 7 odd days ≡ 0 odd days. ∴ Calendar for 2015 is same as 2009.

key_explanation_from_book.ordinary_year: An ordinary year has 365 days, i.e. 52 weeks and 1 odd day.
key_explanation_from_book.leap_year: A leap year has 366 days, i.e. 52 weeks and 2 odd days.
key_explanation_from_book.leap_year_rule: A year divisible by 4 is generally a leap year; century years must also be divisible by 400 to be leap years.
key_explanation_from_book.odd_day: The extra day(s) left after complete weeks are called odd days.
key_explanation_from_book.day_shift: The day of the week advances by the number of odd days contributed by the elapsed years/months.
key_explanation_from_book.calendar_method: Use the number of odd days before the required date and combine them with the known weekday to determine the target day.
